posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Saturday. They gave me a pill last night. It made me sleepy. I don’t understand that. It’s like giving me a pill to be furry. I’m already furry! I can sleep just fine. Also, I love you.”

I was born and raised in NYC. I just don’t think this is true. Some people are New Yorkers but born in the wrong place (apologies to Peter Schramm). But, not everyone who moves to NYC will ever be a real NYer. It’s almost like it’s a state of mind. 

Also: My God does JLo look good.


SubwayTakes with Kareem Rahma (@SubwayTakes)

You have to be born in New York to be a New Yorker!! @JLo
